summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 67/84)

data.turoyo: Čiko qaṭuno bu tanuro, latimi aʕ ʕəbugre kkulle bu tanuro su qatuno. Omər: "Faḥeluli." Əmmi: "hat ənfiḥel, qṭilox ab babayḏan."
data.translation: Der Kater schlüpfte in den Backofen, und alle Mäuse versammelten sich dort bei ihm; er sprach: "So schliesst, denn Frieden mit mir!" Sie antworteten: "Mache du Friedensvorschläge, da du doch unsre Väter getötet hast."

rationale: Missing Detransitive Imperativ box; exact ənfiḥel and the edition’s interpretive Friedensvorschläge are preserved, without asserting a specialized seek-forgiveness sense.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (MAC NE Interview 2/239)

data.turoyo: <...> Dhowənwa emeklí ma+d̥koṯani, əmmiwa “Mšāl b̥kēf d̥ TtayzaT, konušqina iḏa, kəbʕina dəmfaḥlolan!
data.translation: <...> When they would become retired from these places, they would say, ‘Ask how auntie is doing (lit. ‘ask about the auntie’s well-being’), give her a kiss for us (lit. ‘we are kissing her hand’), we want her to forgive us’.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; third-person feminine forgiver and first-person plural forgiven group.

data.translation: He says, ‘Now then, go onto Uriah’s grave for him to forgive you, barefoot’ <...>

data.turoyo: Maləflele šadox ḥəworo l qarʕe. Əmmi aʕ ʕəbugre: "Ayko gəmfaḥlina ḥḏoḏe?" Omər: "Bu tanuro."
data.translation: dabei band er sich eine weisse Binde um den Kopf. Die Mäuse fragten; "Wo wollen wir mit einander Frieden schliessen?" "Im Backofen", entgegnete der Kater.

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; active reciprocal ḥḏoḏe rather than Detransitive morphology.

data.turoyo: <...> Azze u qaṭuno dlo galdo, qrele laʕ ʕəbugre, omər: "Toxu faḥeluli, gəzzino lu ḥəǧ."
data.translation: <...> Ohne Haut ging der Kater hin, rief den Mäusen und sagte: "Kommt, schliesst Frieden mit mir! ich will auf die Wallfahrt gehen";

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell; plural addressees and first-person suffix.

data.turoyo: “E”, — məlle, — “mən omannalxu? faḥeləlli, mu sabab d ramḥəl gədqəṭlili, gədmoyaṯno.”
data.translation: "Ach", sprach er, "was soll ich euch sagen? Entschuldigt mich; denn Morgen wird man mich töten, ich werde sterben."

rationale: Thin Imperativ cell; farewell pardon request beyond a food context.

before: to forgive, make considered ḥalāl (Ilyas p.c.: about food only); to give (something) to (someone) willingly (?)
after: to forgive; make considered ḥalāl (Ilyas p.c.: about food only); to give (something) to (someone) willingly (?)
rationale: Separate interpersonal forgiveness from the consultant’s food restriction on making ḥalāl. Uriah’s grievance and the condemned speaker’s farewell support general pardon; preserve the original informant attribution and uncertain giving clause.

summary: The II sense includes personal pardon with l-suffixed forgiven people. The wrong or claim can remain unexpressed; it is not always food.
In PrS67/83 reciprocity is an overt ḥḏoḏe object of active gəmfaḥlina. It does not establish a Detransitive stem.
The Detransitive command ənfiḥel is attested once; its specific function remains unresolved. Its first printed context also supplies the active command, avoiding duplicate publication in that cell.
The existing poultry confession is PrS71/86 under legacy prs203/26. Do not duplicate it or infer a new reconciliation sense from the edition’s versöhne dich.
In Interview2/239 does the aunt release claims over hospitality/food, or forgive people generally? Eating/drinking context alone does not resolve that scope.
PrS67/84 ənfiḥel: be reconciled, be forgiven or seek forgiveness? Confirm vocalism and intended argument roles; the German Friedensvorschläge is interpretive.
Clarify the scope of Ilyas’s about food only restriction while retaining its attribution. General pardon is independently supported by the existing example and new corpus.
Do the existing Detransitive Infectum mifaḥlat and Infinitiv feḥolo have the same pardon/rights sense? No translation is supplied for those inherited forms.
Capitalize the substantivized adjective in etwas Böses
rationale: After 'etwas', the substantivized adjective 'Böses' is capitalized. This is an orthographic correction to the existing translation.
